# Cardinal Foundation Services

> Engineer-owned foundation repair and commercial concrete contractor in Fort Worth, Texas, serving Dallas-Fort Worth, the Houston area, and Texas. Residential, commercial, and new construction. Every inspection produces a written report with mapped elevation readings, and sometimes the honest recommendation is that no repair is needed.

Company facts: Cardinal Foundation Services, LLC. Fort Worth, TX. (972) 656-8251. Co-owned by Josh Lavelle and Daneel Nortier, PE (licensed Texas Professional Engineer since 2012, License #113157). BBB A+. 4.9 on Google (39 reviews). Transferable workmanship warranty, terms vary by service. Residential quotes are written quotes delivered within one business day of the inspection; commercial scopes are engineered bids. Financing is available on residential work only.

## Residential services (DFW Metroplex and the Houston area)

- [Residential foundation repair](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/): free inspection report with a mapped elevation survey
- [Steel piers](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/steel-piers/)
- [Drilled piers](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/drilled-piers/)
- [Concrete pressed piers](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/concrete-pressed-piers/)
- [Helical piers](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/helical-piers/)
- [Hybrid piers](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/hybrid-piers/)
- [Slab repair](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/slab-repair/)
- [Post-tension slab repair](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/post-tension-slab-repair/)
- [Pier and beam repair](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/foundation-repair/pier-and-beam/)
- [Concrete leveling](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/concrete-leveling/): [poly slab lifting](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/concrete-leveling/polyurethane-foam-injection/), [mudjacking](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/concrete-leveling/mudjacking/), [crack repair](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/concrete-leveling/concrete-crack-repair/)
- [Drainage](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/drainage/): [french drains](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/drainage/french-drains/), [area drains](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/drainage/area-drains/), [root barriers](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/drainage/root-barriers/), [sump pumps](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/drainage/sump-pumps/), [hydrostatic testing](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/drainage/hydrostatic-testing/)
- [Retaining walls](https://cardinalfoundationservices.com/residential/retaining-walls/)
